ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (17) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Ламенэ» (Lamene) is Félicité Lamennais and «Барбэ» (Barbe) his friend and executor Auguste Barbet; Montalembert and Lacordaire are given in their usual forms. Titles are translated from Tolstoy's Russian: «Опыт о равнодушии в делах веры» (Opyt o ravnodushii v delakh very, Essai sur l'indifférence), «Консерватор» (Konservator, Le Conservateur), «Будущность» (Budushchnost', L'Avenir), «Слова верующего» (Slova veruyushchego, Paroles d'un croyant). «Фазис» (fazis) is 'phase', «совершенство / совершенствование» (sovershenstvo / sovershenstvovanie) 'perfection / perfecting', and the French «l'oeuvre» is kept as printed.
